final_message:
I fixed the bug in `billing/engine.py`, in `Engine.__init__`. The full suite now passes (24 tests). I reproduced your test as a temporary file and deleted it afterwards, so it isn't in the repo.

The line that builds the context read `dunning_policy and DEFAULT_POLICY`. With no policy passed, that gives `None`, so `record_failure` crashed on `policy["retry_offsets_days"]` as soon as a customer without a card failed to pay. With a custom policy passed, it would have silently swapped in the default, which was wrong too. I changed `and` to `or`.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repo root: `{"file": "engine.py", "function": "__init__"}`.

steps.command: ls billing && wc -l billing/*.py && grep -n "def subscribe" -A60 billing/*.py | head -120
cat billing/payments.py billing/dunning.py; grep -n "card" tests/conftest.py billing/customers.py billing/gateway.py

cat > /tmp/t.py <<'E'
from tests.conftest import *
E
cat >> tests/test_tmp.py <<'E'
def test_customer_without_card_enters_dunning(world):
    cus = world.customer(card=False)
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["attempt_count"] == 1
    assert inv["next_attempt_at"] is not None
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
E
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_tmp.py 2>&1 | tail -30; sed -n 1,60p billing/customers.py; grep -n "def create" -A60 billing/subscriptions.py
rm tests/test_tmp.py; grep -rn "dunning_policy" billing tests | head -20; cat billing/context.py

sed -i 's/dunning_policy and DEFAULT_POLICY/dunning_policy or DEFAULT_POLICY/' billing/engine.py && echo '{"file": "engine.py", "function": "__init__"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
